DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……もう季節は夏、か

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 夏だね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そして夏と言えば、海だね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん、海ね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……先生？ちゃんとそこにいる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 全力でモモトーク見てるよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふぅ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 夏だから、心が浮足立つのは分かるけれど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生までそんなテンションだと、何だかやる事が増えそうで困る

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 仕事っていうのは、常に増えていくもの

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: こういう時期も例外じゃない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 風紀を乱す生徒たちは、いつどこにでもいる。夏だから尚更

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……だから、ちょっと手伝ってほしい

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: さすが、夏でもヒナちゃんは真面目だね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 夏の風紀委員長も隙が無いね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……まずは、風紀を乱しそうな先生から処理した方が良い？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: すみませんでした

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はあ、まったく……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、場所はこの後送るから。待ってる

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日はありがとう、先生。合宿の参考になった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その、今度の夏の合宿でも、もし余裕があれば一緒に……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いや

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何でもない

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 時間を見つけて、一緒に遊べるといいね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……先生、今夜の約束だけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 別の日にずらしても大丈夫？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと、仕事が終わりそうになくて

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: あれ、ごめん、今日だったっけ……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫だよ、全然気にしないで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……もしかして、今日じゃなくて明日？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私の勘違いだったかも、忘れて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……うん、ありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 最近ずっと、バタバタしてて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: いつも以上に忙しそうだね……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 大したことじゃない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まあ、ちょっと色んなスケジュールをずらさないといけなくなったくらいで……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ただ、今日は一歩も外に出られてないし、書類仕事で一日が終わりそう

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫！？休んで！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まあ、よくあることだから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: とにかく、先生とこうしてやり取りできただけで、ちょっとスッキリした

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ一旦仕事を片付けないとだから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: また後で

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日は手伝ってくれてありがとう、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大したことじゃないよ、どういたしまして

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: すごく助かった。でも、毎回こうして迷惑をかけるわけにはいかないから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 次は、もう少し仕事を早く終わらせておく

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そしたら、その……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: せっかくここまで来たんだし……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 少しくらい、一緒に外を出歩くのも良いかな……って

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その時は今日みたいにエスコート、お願いしても良い？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日はもしかしたら、午前中に仕事が片付くかもしれない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だからその

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 喜んで！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……本題に入る前に、返事をしないで。本当に分かってるの……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 全くもう……とにかく

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この前言ってたでしょう、リゾート地まで来て満喫しないのは勿体ないって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そうだよ！せっかく海に来たんだから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……それで良いのかなって、まだ心のどこかでは思ってるのだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生が、そこまで言うのなら……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日の午後、付き合ってくれる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その、多分

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 一緒に海に遊びに行くくらいの時間は取れるはず

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん！楽しみにしてるね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん、じゃあ……またお昼頃に

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日は楽しかった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: たまにはあんな風に、ゆっくり海を眺めるのも悪くない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今度は、

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……だから、先読みしないでって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、本当に変な人

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん、じゃあその時もお願いね。先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その、時間大丈夫？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、もちろん！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ヒナの連絡なら、大丈夫じゃなくても大丈夫だよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そう？よかった……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ？先生、あの。どっち……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 何かあったの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、その……大したことじゃない、んだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もし、よかったら……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 水泳を、教えてほしくて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、もちろんだよ。急いで向かうね。

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生？ちょっと、まだ詳しい話を……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あの……？先生？

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 히나의 말을 허투루 들을 리가 없잖아!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 당신까지 그렇게 늘어져 있으면 나까지 곤란해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 일이라는 건 언제나 어느 때나 쌓이는 법이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 과연 수영복 차림이어도 히나 쨩은 성실하구나!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼, 이번 여름 합숙에서는 반드시 같이…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응. 같이 놀 수 있었으면 좋겠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아아, ……그건 오늘 했던 약속이 아니었던 걸까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘은 순찰 업무 대신 서류 작성으로 하루를 보내게 될 것 같아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어쨌거나 선생과 대화를 나누고 나니 조금 후련해졌어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 아직 남은 업무가 있다 보니 이만.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 하지만 언제까지고 이런 식으로 폐만 끼칠 순 없으니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다음번엔 좀 더 업무를 빨리 끝내두고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응, 선생 말대로, 조금은 쉬는 것도 좋을지 모르겠네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생, 오늘은 일찍 업무 처리를 시작했으니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아마 남은 일도 오전 중에 다 마무리가 될 것 같아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아니……, 본론을 꺼내기 전에 먼저 대답부터 해도 곤란하거든……?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 휴양지까지 와서, 쉬지 않는 건 엄청 아까운 일이라고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응. 그럼……. 이따 점심쯤에 봐. 선생

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 가끔은 이렇게, 바다를 바라보는 것도 나쁘지 않네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응, 그럼 그때에도 잘 부탁해. 선생.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 으응? 저기, 선생님. 무슨 소리인지 잘 모르겠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 히나, 어떤 일 때문에 그래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그거라면 완전 환영이야! 지금 바로 갈게!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응? 선생님? 저기, 나, 자세한 이야기를 아직……

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's summertime, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Yeah, summertime!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: And when you think of the summer, you think of beaches!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yup. Summer. Beaches.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you paying attention?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Of course!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I always pay attention to you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: *sigh*

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I know it's the summer...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But if you start slacking off, that affects everyone.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Work is work, all the time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Even at times like this.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There will always be immoral criminals out there.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That's why I need your help, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You're so diligent, even in your swimsuit, Hina!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: The head prefect is even better in her swimsuit!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Maybe I should arrest a certain immoral sensei, then.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm sorry. What do you need?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: *sigh* Honestly...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Come to the location I told you of before. I'll be waiting.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you for helping me out with today's task, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then, for real this time for the summer camp...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: N-Never mind.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Right, I hope we can spend time together.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: About today's dinner plans, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Can we push them back a little bit?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm still swamped with work.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sure. Wait, did we ever...?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Really? Well, I guess there's nothing we can do about it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Wait. Was that not something planned for today?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I guess I remembered it wrong. Please forget I said anything.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you for your understanding.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've been very busy lately.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: So you're stressed out?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No, it's nothing too serious.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It just means I have to move my schedule around.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll be spending today on paperwork rather than patrolling.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: But that IS something serious!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, it's not that rare for me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyway, I'm feeling better after talking to you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I need to get back to work.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Talk to you later.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I feel refreshed. Thank you for helping, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You're welcome.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But I can't just keep imposing on you like this...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll finish off my work a bit faster.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And then I...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Since we're here already...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You're right. Now would be a good time to rest.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I hope you'll be with me like you were today when the time comes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I began work earlier than normal today, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I should be finished later this morning.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So would you like to...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Yes! I'm in!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But... I hadn't even finished asking.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You really are something. Anyway, you said before...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It would be a waste not to have fun during vacation.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Right, since we're at the beach.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I don't understand, personally.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But if you insist, Sensei...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Very well. Would you spend the afternoon with me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Maybe just visiting the beach shore

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: is something...I might be able to do.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sure thing!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay, then... See you around lunchtime, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Today was fun.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Taking in the beach is fine every once in a while.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Until next time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Say no more!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You didn't let me finish again.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee. You're so odd.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: All right, then. I'll be looking forward to it, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you, by any chance...free today?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Yes, of course!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: For you, Hina, I'd have time even if I didn't have time!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh, really? That's a relief.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What? Uh, Sensei, I really don't understand what that means...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: So what did you need?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah, it's just...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, if you don't mind, Sensei, I just wanted to learn to swim.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But, it's fine if you need time to...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: In that case, I'd be happy to! I'll be right there!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What? Sensei? I wasn't finished explaining.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hello? Sensei?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ฤดูร้อนละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ใช่แล้ว~ ฤดูร้อนแล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: พอพูดถึงฤดูร้อนก็ต้องทะเลสิ~!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ทะเล

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่านข้อความอยู่ใช่มั้ย...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แน่นอน ครูอ่านอยู่!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูจะกล้าเมินข้อความของฮินะได้ยังไง!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เฮ้อ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันเข้าใจนะว่าตอนนี้เป็นฤดูร้อน
เลยเอ้อระเหยกัน...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ถ้าคุณครูเอ้อระเหยแบบนี้อีกคน
ทุกคนจะทำตามนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งานที่ต้องทำน่ะ มันงอกได้ดีกว่าเห็ด
อีกนะรู้มั้ย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เวลาแบบนี้ก็เหมือนกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีพวกนักเรียนที่ไม่ทำตามกฎอยู่ตลอด

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะงั้นฉันเลยอยากให้คุณครู
ช่วยหน่อย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ฮินะจังนี่ถึงใส่ชุดว่ายน้ำ
ก็จริงจังอยู่ตลอดเลยนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงจะใส่ชุดว่ายน้ำแต่ก็ยังเป็น
ประธานกรรมการวินัยสินะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หรือฉันควรเริ่มจากจัดการคุณครู
ที่ชอบก่อกวนก่อนดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูผิดไปแล้ว
มีอะไรให้ช่วยงั้นเหรอ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เฮ้อ... จริงๆ เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มาเจอกันที่จุดนัดพบที่ฉันบอกไปด้วยล่ะ
ฉันจะรออยู่ที่นั่น

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ขอบคุณที่ร่วมมือในภารกิจวันนี้นะ
คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้น เข้าค่ายฤดูร้อนปีนี้พวกเรา...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มะ...ไม่มีอะไรหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ถะ...ถ้าได้ไปเที่ยวด้วยกันก็คงดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู นัดกินข้าวเย็นนี้น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันขอเลื่อนเวลาหน่อยได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พอดียังมีงานค้างอยู่น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เอ๊ะ? เรานัดกันด้วยเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเหรอ? ช่วยไม่ได้นะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวนะ เราไม่ได้นัดกันวันนี้เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าฉันจำผิดละก็ลืมๆ ไปก็ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ขอบคุณที่เข้าใจนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ช่วงนี้ฉันยุ่งจนหัวหมุนไปหมดเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ยุ่งขนาดนั้นเลยเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม... ก็ไม่ได้ขนาดนั้นหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็แค่ต้องโยกย้ายตารางงานนิดหน่อย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
วันนี้ฉันคงต้องจัดการงานเอกสาร
แทนการออกไปลาดตระเวนแล้วล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แบบนั้นแสดงว่ายุ่งมากเลยนะ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็นะ ฉันเจอจนชินแล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่รู้ทำไมพอได้คุยกับคุณครู
ฉันก็รู้สึกดีขึ้นมากเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ขอตัวก่อนนะ ฉันต้องไปทำงาน
ต่อแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้ค่อยคุยกันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงจะรู้สึกแปลกๆ นิดหน่อย
แต่ขอบคุณที่มาช่วยนะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูยินดีที่ได้ช่วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันจะเอาแต่สร้างปัญหาให้คุณครู
ต่อไปก็คงไม่ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เอาไว้คราวหน้าฉันจะรีบทำงานให้เสร็จนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้ว... เอ่อ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไหนๆ ก็มาถึงที่นี่แล้ว...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พักสักหน่อยตามที่คุณครูบอก
ก็คงดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หวังว่าคราวหน้า คุณครูจะมาด้วยกันอีกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู วันนี้ฉันทำงานเสร็จเร็ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งานที่เหลืออยู่ก็คงทำเสร็จได้ทั้งหมด
ภายในช่วงเช้า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพราะงั้น...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อออ! ได้แน่นอน!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เดี๋ยวสิ... ตอบก่อนที่ฉันจะพูด
ได้ยังไง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ก็นะ... เหมือนที่คุณครูบอกไว้ไง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อุตส่าห์ได้มาเที่ยวทั้งที
ถ้าไม่ใช้เวลาให้คุ้มก็น่าเสียดาย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: นั่นสิ มาทะเลทั้งทีเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถึงฉันไม่ค่อยเข้าใจเท่าไหร่

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ถ้าคุณครูยืนกรานแบบนั้น...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นตอนบ่ายไปเดินเล่นกันมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าแค่ไปเล่นที่ชายหาดละก็...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: น่าจะไปได้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แน่นอน!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อื้อ ถ้างั้นเดี๋ยวเจอกันตอนเที่ยงๆ นะ
คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้สนุกมากเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ได้มานั่งมองทะเลแบบนี้บ้าง
ก็ไม่เลวเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คราวหน้า...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ได้อยู่แล้ว!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ...ตอบแทรกมาอีกแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮิฮิ แปลกคนจริงๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คราวหน้ามาเที่ยวด้วยกันใหม่นะ
คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คือว่า... วันนี้พอมีเวลารึเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ครูมีเวลาทั้งวันเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าฮินะเรียกละก็
ต่อให้ยุ่งแค่ไหน ครูก็จะไป!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเหรอ? ค่อยยังชั่วหน่อย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หืม? พูดอะไรน่ะ ไม่เห็นเข้าใจเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ว่าแต่ว่าฮินะมีอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ้อ คือว่า... ไม่ใช่เรื่องใหญ่หรอก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าคุณครูสะดวกละก็... ฉันแค่อยาก
เรียนว่ายน้ำน่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: จู่ๆ ก็คิดแบบนั้น...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าเรื่องนั้นละก็ได้เสมอเลย!
ครูจะรีบไปหานะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หืม? คุณครู? ฉันยังไม่ได้บอก
รายละเอียดอะไรเลยนะ...

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為是夏天，所以我可以理解會讓人興奮……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但連老師也這麼情緒高昂的話，總覺得要做的事會增加，很困擾

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所謂的工作，就是會不斷的增加

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 擾亂風紀的學生到處都有。尤其是夏天

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不愧是陽奈，即使是夏天也很認真呢！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 風紀委員長到了夏天也毫不鬆懈！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……首先，先從感覺會帶亂風紀的老師開始處理似乎比較好？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼，地點之後會發送給你。我等著

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天謝謝你，老師。這對合宿很有幫助

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 另外，這次的夏天合宿，如果時間充裕的話，希望能一起……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 能找到時間一起玩的話就好了呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天的工作有點忙不完

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒問題唷，完全不用介意

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 可能是我記錯了，忘了吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 最近一直忙得不可開交……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只不過會需要排開各種待辦事項……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只是今天一步也沒走出去，光是文書工作就結束一整天了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 總之，光是能和老師這樣交流，就放鬆多了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 謝謝你今天的幫助，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒什麼大不了的，不客氣

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 真是幫大忙了。但是，不能每次都這樣給你添麻煩

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下次，我會早點完成工作

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 稍微一起出去走走，似乎也不錯……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 到時候也能像今天一樣帶領著我嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天說不定能在上午就完成工作

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……請不要在進入正題之前就回覆。真的明白了嗎……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之前說過吧，來渡假勝地不享受的話就太可惜了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……雖然我還是多少會覺得這種態度到底好不好

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但既然老師都這麼說了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 能抽出時間一起去海邊玩

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 偶爾像這樣悠閒地眺望大海也不錯

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，到時候也拜託你了。老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 如果是陽奈找我，就算沒空也有空！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師？那個，這樣是有空還是……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，那個……雖然不是什麼，大不了的事……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，當然願意。我很快就到

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師？等等，詳細的事我還沒……
